scope: Close the five R14 P0 findings before real confirmatory execution; preserve P1/P2 as open.

resolved_findings.resolution: Central FeatureResult validity classification now maps nonfinite/invalid/zero-sample data to INVALID_DATA and missing/insufficient data to MISSING_DATA before threshold comparison; conjuncts use the same policy.
Mixed Evidence + Knowledge citations no longer disable measurement grounding; Evidence citation subsets remain numerically validated in Agent narrative and mixed hypothesis claims.
group_id is the preregistered inferential unit. Case-level McNemar is descriptive only; group-direction exact sign inference and equal-group effect estimates are used for promotion.
A7_NO_ACTIVE_PROBE vs A2_CONTROLLED_FULL is separately reported and preregistered as the only estimand allowed to inform future Probe formal-evidence-producer review.

v3 design freezes equal-group effect size, 95% t interval, minimum effect, independent-group count, interval precision and exact group-direction p gates. Inadequate precision requires a new preregistered expanded campaign.

claim_boundary: P0 closure means the engineering confirmatory design is no longer blocked by these five R14 findings. It does not create real A0-A7 results, formal Probe evidence authority, flight qualification, or resolution of the remaining R14 P1/P2 findings.
